name: What permits are needed for sheer descent installation in Pasadena?

mainEntity.name: What permits are needed for sheer descent installation in Pasadena?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Pasadena, as with other areas, adding a water feature like a sheer descent waterfall might require permits if it involves significant plumbing, electrical work, or structural modifications to an existing pool or landscape. For new pool construction including a sheer descent, the entire project will be subject to a comprehensive building permit. It's advisable to consult with your contractor or the City of Pasadena's planning department to confirm specific requirements for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits in Pasadena may be needed if the installation involves significant plumbing, electrical, or structural changes, or if it's part of new pool construction.
